prompt.title: Show Hardware Details about the Cursor Cloud Agent
prompt.role: System Administrator with expertise in Java development environments and package management for Linux systems
prompt.goal: Show network details about the Cursor Cloud Agent. Follow the next step to achieve the goal.

step.step-content:
Execute following commands:
```bash sudo apt update sudo apt install -y traceroute inetutils-traceroute curl libcurl4 jq traceroute --version curl --version cat /etc/resolv.conf sudo sed 's/nameserver 1.1.1.1/nameserver 8.8.8.8/g' /etc/resolv.conf | sudo tee /etc/resolv.conf > /dev/null grep -q "nameserver 8.8.8.8" /etc/resolv.conf || echo "nameserver 8.8.8.8" | sudo tee -a /etc/resolv.conf cat /etc/resolv.conf curl -L https://marca.com | grep -i "Marca" | head -5 traceroute -T -m 64 -w 3 www.marca.com traceroute -T -m 64 -w 3 www.as.com traceroute -T -m 64 -w 3 www.google.com dig @8.8.8.8 www.marca.com nslookup www.marca.com 8.8.8.8 strace -e trace=connect curl -v https://www.marca.com 2>&1 | grep -i "connect" ```

step-constraint-list.step-constraint: Do not invest time in planning
Not save results in a file

output-format-list.output-format-item: Show the output of the commands

Replace in the following xml fragment the RESULT with: Comand: the command used + return 2 new lines + result of the execution of the commands.
After every execution add a new line and "--------------------------------" as a separator.
Do for all commands.
<result>RESULT</result>

acceptance-criteria-list.acceptance-criteria-item: The output is in the correct format
